refusedAttempts.cause: Harness sequencing, not a product defect. A port keeps the source coordination identity; omp->codex and omp->claude were launched from source 42036 concurrently, and psu-pty-host refused the duplicate logical session (single-continuation guard). Re-run sequentially as port 4d15634c: delivered.

puiShape: The PUI ended-session route opens a pane running `psu --resume <adv id>` with no --agent (apps/operator/lib/pui-resume.integration.test.ts header); these runs used that argv headless, on the staging operator.
observations: The ~/.local/bin/psu shim resolves the RELEASE launcher (papercusp-release) unless PAPERCUSP_PSU_LAUNCHER, PAPERCUSP_CANONICAL_TREE or PAPERCUSP_INTEGRATION_ROOT is set, so an owner's bare `psu --resume` gets this behaviour only once green main carries it.
